newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Issing - no current need for rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Issing - no current need for rate cut.

text.p: Bundesbank chief economist Otmar Issing was quoted in a magazine article on Wednesday as repeating his view that there was no current need for a cut in German interest rates.
Issing also told the German Boerse Online magazine that, while there was no present need for a rate cut: "If conditions change, we will review the situation and act accordingly".
Issing added that confidence in currency stability was the most important condition for a reduction in long-term rates.
The Bundesbank economist had said last week that there could be no German rate cuts under present circumstances.
